**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear description of what the problem is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated
when...").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Which layer does this touch?**
(e.g. a new adapter, an effector/tool, the HUD, voice/Live session, the
autonomy/leash tiers) — helps route the request to the right area.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, links, related issues.
